# Copilot instructions

This repository contains two applications. Follow the nearest scoped instructions before changing code:

- `backend/AGENTS.md` for the Spring Boot API, Java, Maven, and backend feature workflow.
- `frontend/AGENTS.md` for the Ionic Angular application.
- `AGENTS.md` for conventions shared across the monorepo.

The project custom agents under `.github/agents/` and `.codex/agents/` currently support backend feature and TDD work. Use them only for backend feature tasks; they are kept at the repository root for editor/tool discovery.
